system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — James River Coal Company realized record after the August 2014 asset sale

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`

> structured at closing. Outcome window fixed at construction: James River Coal Company's
> realized record for the ~3-5 years after the August 29, 2014 closing (i.e. ~August 2017
> through ~August 2019).

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- The registrant filed no annual report (Form 10-K) after the Form 10-K for the fiscal year
  ended December 31, 2012 (accession 0001019687-13-000763, filed March 8, 2013); no audited
  public financial statements were filed for any fiscal year in or bearing on the fixed
  outcome window. [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions record for CIK 1297720 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001297720.json)]
- After selling substantially all of its operating assets, the registrant remained a
  Chapter 11 debtor and its subsequent public filings consisted of Current Reports on Form
  8-K furnishing monthly operating reports filed with the Bankruptcy Court. [SRC: SEC accession 0001019687-16-005084, Form 8-K Item 7.01]
- The last such periodic public filing was the Form 8-K filed February 8, 2016, furnishing
  the monthly operating report for the period ended December 31, 2015; as of that filing the
  Chapter 11 Cases remained jointly administered under Case No. 14-31848 in the U.S.
  Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of Virginia (Richmond Division). [SRC: SEC accession 0001019687-16-005084, Form 8-K Item 7.01]

## Realized record over the fixed outcome window
- Within the fixed outcome window, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission revoked the
  registration of the registrant's securities: EDGAR records a filing of form type REVOKED
  dated April 24, 2019 (accession 9999999997-19-003342) on the registrant's filing history.
  [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions record for CIK 1297720, form REVOKED, accession 9999999997-19-003342, filed 2019-04-24 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001297720.json)]
- No Form 10-K, Form 20-F or other periodic report was filed by the registrant during the
  fixed outcome window; consequently no primary-source financial scalar (net income/loss,
  goodwill or asset write-down, impairment, or divestiture proceeds) attributable to the
  registrant for the outcome window is publicly available. [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions record for CIK 1297720 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001297720.json)]

## Outcome coding note
- The registrant did not continue as a reporting going concern: it ceased periodic public
  reporting after the February 2016 monthly-operating-report filing while still a Chapter 11
  debtor that had sold substantially all of its operating assets, and its Exchange Act
  registration was revoked on April 24, 2019 (within the window). Because there is no public
  audited 3-5-year financial record for the registrant, any financial outcome scalar for the
  window is coded **uncertain (no public record)** — this is a documented deregistration,
  primary-sourced, not a data gap; it is not inferred from any third party's results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001019687-16-005084, Form 8-K Item 7.01] [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions record for CIK 1297720, form REVOKED, accession 9999999997-19-003342 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001297720.json)]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Over the fixed ~August 2017-August 2019 window the registrant produced no audited public
  financial record: it never filed an annual report after fiscal 2012, its last public
  periodic filing was a February 2016 8-K furnishing a monthly operating report while still
  a Chapter 11 debtor under Case No. 14-31848, and the SEC revoked its securities
  registration on April 24, 2019. The realized financial outcome for the window is therefore
  coded uncertain (no public record), with the traceable realized facts limited to the
  cessation of periodic reporting and the registration revocation. [SRC: SEC accession 0001019687-16-005084, Form 8-K Item 7.01] [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions record for CIK 1297720, form REVOKED, accession 9999999997-19-003342 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001297720.json)]

[SLICE END]
